notes.title: 🌎 Around the World 5: Beautiful America Collector's Edition — out today!
notes.content:
[p]The new chapter of the [i]Around the World[/i] series is here! Embark on an unforgettable journey across the most picturesque corners of the USA — from majestic canyons and national parks to bustling metropolises and cozy coastal towns.[/p][p]This is more than just a hidden object game — it’s a true virtual adventure:
🔎 Over 30 colorful, detailed locations filled with atmosphere.
🧩 Engaging mini-games and logical puzzles.
🎶 Relaxing music and a leisurely pace — play at your own speed.
🎁 Souvenirs and collectibles to preserve your travel memories.[/p][p][b]Collector’s Edition makes the journey even brighter:[/b]
✨ Unique bonus scenes and quests.
✨ Exclusive mini-games for true genre lovers.
✨ Save your favorite landscapes as wallpapers in your personal gallery.[/p][p]Dive into the beauty of America, escape the rush, and enjoy a journey without leaving home!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609910/Around_the_World_5_Beautiful_America_Collectors_Edition/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Amazing Weekend 3: A New Cozy Adventure in Hidden Object Search – Available Now!
notes.content:
[p][b]Embark on a Cozy Adventure![/b][/p][p]Time to escape the hustle and immerse yourself in tranquility. Enjoy breathtaking landscapes, puzzles, and collections—the perfect way to relax and have fun.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478690/Amazing_Weekend_3__Search_and_Relax_Collectors_Edition/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][b]What's New in This Edition?[/b][/p][p]✔ 3 item search modes—classic, time-limited, and expert mode for the most attentive.
✔ Puzzles and mini-games—test your wits with various challenges.
✔ Souvenir collection—gather unique items and complete your album.
✔ Bonus content—exclusive wallpapers, background music, and other delightful extras.
➕ 12 new levels, 8 mini-games from the previous edition, a themed souvenir shop, and special quests for animal lovers.[/p][p][b]Special Offer for Fans:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][i]Amazing Weekend 2: Search & Relax Collection Edition[/i]—demo version now available for all users![/p][/*][*][p]Discount on the full version of Part 2—valid all next week.
